# Nelson Inno – Full Profile

## Identity
Name: Nelson Inno
Nationality: Salvadoran
Based: San Salvador, El Salvador

Positioning: El Salvador and Central America's reference on innovation, technology, and artificial intelligence. Helps enterprises, governments, and universities adopt AI and emerging technology, with education and training as his deepest expertise. Specializations: AI implementation and automation, and education and training.
Website: https://nelsoninno.com
Sitemap: https://nelsoninno.com/sitemap.xml

## Biography
Nelson Inno is a Salvadoran entrepreneur, the founder and CEO of WeSpark, and the author of Unstable Innovation. He is a leading reference on innovation, technology, and AI in El Salvador and Central America. He helps enterprises, governments, and universities adopt AI and emerging technology, with education and training as his deepest expertise, and turns strategy into working implementation, automation, and training. He also co-founded everybodyknowsyou, an AI-native web hosting and discoverability venture connecting Central America to AI search engines. He co-designed Bitcoin Diploma 2.0 with El Salvador's National Bitcoin Office, a curriculum the country's Ministry of Education plans to bring to up to 500,000 students over the coming years.

His work has been featured in Forbes Centroamérica, ARD, ZDF, Cointelegraph, and El Salvador's press. His TEDx talk, "Are Schools Prepared for the Future?", explores how learning must change for people to thrive in the world they will actually live in.

## Specializations
1. AI and technology implementation: turning innovation, technology, and AI strategy into programs, systems, and automations that actually ship, for enterprises, governments, and universities.
2. Education and training: AI-powered learning built on strong visualization and interactivity, AI-fluency training, corporate training, curriculum and learning design, and national-scale education programs.

## Mantra
"Be the ordinary, build the extraordinary."

## Philosophy
Three directional preferences: slow rather than fast (with intention and focus), quality rather than quantity, calmness rather than noise.

Three operating principles:
1. Add value to others.
2. Focus on what truly matters.
3. Never forget your roots.

## Featured Work

### Bitcoin Diploma 2.0 (2025-present)
A complete redesign of El Salvador's flagship Bitcoin and modern finance curriculum, built with the National Bitcoin Office (ONBTC) under the direction of Stacy Herbert. Officially announced by Nelson at Bitcoin Histórico in November 2025. Being rolled out by the Ministry of Education with a national reach goal of up to 500,000 students.
Coverage: Cointelegraph en Español, ARD/ZDF Bitcoineros, El Salvador in English, Diario El Salvador, news.bitcoin.com

### ADDN Technology & Innovation Advisor (2024-present)
Ad-honorem Technology and Innovation Advisor to the ADDN (Agency for National Development and Design), El Salvador's strategic planning body. Work centers on megatrends strategy for national planning, AI-fluency training for government teams, and design and implementation of AI systems to modernize government operations.

### Gloria Kriete Foundation (2020-present)
A multi-year partnership with one of Central America's most respected educational foundations. WeSpark has supported Programa Oportunidades through workshops, curriculum design, and trainer development. Formalized through a Memorandum of Understanding in 2022, renewed in 2025.

## Books
- Unstable Innovation (January 2025): Written for innovators navigating uncertainty and the gap between corporate frameworks and what works in the field. Read by more than 2,000 innovators since launch. Available at unstableinnovation.com
- Diplomado en Bitcoin: Curso Oficial (April 2026): El Salvador's official national Bitcoin curriculum, co-published with MINED and ONBTC.
- Thinking in Images (forthcoming 2026): A framework for translating complex ideas into visual communication, influenced by Feynman's method and seven years of visual-first pedagogy.

## Career Timeline
- 2026-present: Co-Founder & CTO, everybodyknowsyou (EKY), San Salvador. AI-native web hosting and discoverability infrastructure connecting Central America to AI search engines; around 90% of operations run autonomously
- 2026: Bitcoin Diploma 2.0 finalized (National Bitcoin Office of El Salvador, co-designed with WeSpark)
- 2025: Co-founded WeSpark S.A.S. de C.V. in El Salvador (San Salvador, with Adam Nili)
- 2023-2024: Co-Founder, EarnB (Bitcoin-only marketing platform, Frankfurt)
- 2019-present: Founder & CEO, WeSpark (Frankfurt to San Salvador)
- 2016-2019: Lufthansa Group, Frankfurt. Senior Innovation Manager (2017-2019) and ProTeam Member (2016-2017); built four new innovation departments and strategies across Lufthansa Group companies
- 2015-2017: MBA, Sales and Service Engineering, Furtwangen University, Germany
- 2010-2016: Early roles and internships in El Salvador. Microsoft intern (2015), project leader at Aeroman (2015-2016), Business Intelligence consultant at Avianca (2013), and Siemens apprenticeship (2010)
- 2012-2015: Marquardt Group, Germany. Business Intelligence Strategy Intern (2014-2015) and Sales Project Developer (2012-2013), with strategy work for Marquardt India as bachelor thesis
- 2010-2013: BEng Industrial Engineering / Product Development Engineering, Furtwangen University, Germany
- 1991-2009: Born and raised in El Salvador. German School of San Salvador, International Baccalaureate Diploma
